items.title: Sharon Osbourne: 'I visit Ozzy's grave every day'
items.titleZh: 莎伦·奥斯本：“我每天都去看奥兹的墓”
items.body: TV host Sharon Osbourne says she visits Ozzy's grave every day. She can see his burial place from her window and often talks to him.
items.bodyZh: 电视主持人莎伦·奥斯本说，她每天都去看奥兹的墓地。她从窗户就能看到他的安葬之处，还经常和他说话。

items.title: Sunday Puzzle: BRB
items.body: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe plays the weekly puzzle with puzzle master Will Shortz. This week's player is Jordan Bogdan, a listener from Oak Ridge, Tennessee.
items.bodyZh: NPR 的阿伊莎·拉斯科与谜题大师威尔·肖茨一起玩每周谜题。本周的参与者是来自田纳西州橡树岭的听众乔丹·博格丹。

items.title: When a teen posts a selfie, how much filter is 'too much' filter?
items.titleZh: 青少年发自拍时，滤镜加到什么程度算“太过”？
items.body: A recent Meta settlement includes a rule that bans 'cosmetic procedure filters' for teens. However, it is hard to define when a filter causes an extreme makeover.
items.bodyZh: 最近 Meta 的一项和解协议包含一条规定，禁止青少年使用“整容手术滤镜”。但是，很难界定一个滤镜何时会造成过度改头换面。

items.title: Eric Bauza, voice of Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck, dies aged 46
items.titleZh: 兔八哥和达菲鸭配音演员埃里克·鲍扎去世，享年46岁
items.body: Eric Bauza, the voice of Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck, has died at 46. He also voiced several characters in this summer's animated hit Coyote vs. Acme.
items.bodyZh: 兔八哥和达菲鸭的配音演员埃里克·鲍扎去世，享年46岁。他还为今年夏天的动画热门片《郊狼大战阿克米》中的多个角色配音。

items.title: What makes a good spine-tingler? Stephen Graham Jones says it's all in the ending
items.titleZh: 怎样才算好看的恐怖故事？斯蒂芬·格雷厄姆·琼斯说关键在结局
items.body: Horror writer Stephen Graham Jones says a good scary story depends on its ending. He also believes today's horror boom is driven by more than fear.
items.bodyZh: 恐怖作家斯蒂芬·格雷厄姆·琼斯说，一个好的恐怖故事取决于它的结局。他还认为，如今恐怖作品的流行不仅仅是因为恐惧。

items.title: AI found the flaw. Hackers found the leak: The race to save 'PHP2SHELL'
items.titleZh: AI发现了漏洞，黑客发现了泄露：拯救“PHP2SHELL”的竞赛
items.body: AI found a security flaw in a part of the internet called PHP2SHELL. Researchers hurried to fix it, but news of the problem leaked. Hackers then moved in quickly.
items.bodyZh: AI在互联网架构中一个名为 PHP2SHELL 的部分发现了一个安全漏洞。研究人员赶紧修复它，但问题的消息泄露了。黑客随后迅速介入。
